ወልዲ: ወልድ — my son (noun + 1cs suffix -ī, written -ዲ; variant of ወልድየ) (?) · his son (noun + -ዲ for 3ms -ሁ 'his', Bezold's spelling; ለሰሎሞን ወልዲ 'to Solomon, his son'; ለአድራሚ ወልዲ 'Adrami, his son')

አውረደ: አውረደ — he brought down (3ms perfect, causative of ወረደ)

ይተረጐም: ተርጐመ — it is interpreted (3ms imperfect ይተረጐም, passive/reflexive ተ-stem)
አብ: አብ — father (the Father) · a father in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ)

ወልድ: ወልድ — son (the Son) · a son in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ 'a father's blessing upon a son')
ወአመ: አመ — and when, on the day that (ወ- + conjunction/preposition)

ወደቂቁ: ደቂቅ — and his children, sons (ወ- + noun + -u 'his')
እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?) · 'of' before a genitive, standing for the feminine relative (ሃይማኖት እንተ አበው ሐዋርያት 'the faith of the fathers, the apostles'; ሃይማኖተ እንተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'the faith of the Church') · fem. relative before a verb with the object understood (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ 'the flesh which he took')
ለብሰ: ለብሰ — he put on, clothed himself in (3ms perfect)
ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
አርአያ: አርአያ — image, likeness · 'vision, appearance' (ዘከመዝ አርአያ ዘርኢከ 'such a vision as you saw', ch. 56)
ወአምሳለ: አምሳል — and likeness of (ወ- + noun, construct)
ወልደ: ወልድ — son (noun, construct state 'son-of') · accusative 'a son' (ወለደት ወልደ 'she bore a son')
ዘኮነ: ኮነ — that which was (ዘ- 'that which' + 3ms perfect, k-w-n)

ወረደ: ወረደ — he went down, descended (3ms perfect, G, w-r-d) · ወ is part of the root, not 'and'
ወሞተ: ሞተ — and he died (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, m-w-t)
በሥጋሁ: ሥጋ — in his body, flesh (በ- + noun + -hu)
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
መለኮቱ: መለኮት — his divinity, godhead (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', form መለኮቱ)
ኮነት: ኮነ — become, be (3fs perfect; subject መንግሥተ) · 'if it is' after እመ, the subject the unborn child (ወእመሂ ኮነት ወለተ 'and if it is a daughter') · 'was' of place (ማኅደሩ ለእግዚኣብሔር ኮነት ህየ 'God's dwelling was there', ch. 95)
ተዐውቀ: ዐወቀ — it was/has become known (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ዐወቀ 'know' (?); rendered as a present 'it is known')
ለሰብእ: ሰብእ — for man, as men (ለ- + noun 'man, human being')
በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam') · 'because' before a perfect verb (በእንተ ተዘብጡ 'because they were struck') · 'because' before ዘ- + verb (በእንተ ዘነሥኦሙ 'because he took them'; በእንተ ዘአፍቀርኪያ 'because you loved her')
ለዛቲ: ዛቲ — to this, of this (ለ- + fem. demonstrative ዛቲ before ትውልድ) · ለ- marking the object before a demonstrative (ኢንሰምዓ ለዛቲ ቃለ 'let us not hear this word')
አምላክ: አምላክ — God, god (noun, singular; here 'a God') · 'god' in ዘእምአምላክ 'that is from god' (no article)
ወስምዑ: ሰምዐ — hear, listen (2mp imperative, G stem; ወ- 'and')
ዘውእቱ: ውእቱ — who is, namely (ዘ- relative + 3ms pronoun)

እምዐፅመ: ዐፅም — from the bone of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
ተፈጥረት: ተፈጥረ — she was created (3fs perfect, passive of ፈጠረ; subject ታቦት) · 'it was brought about' with fem. subject ስሕተተ (ስሕተተ ተባዕት ተፈጥረት 'the error of the man came about') · with the feminine noun መደኀኒትክሙ 'your salvation' as subject
ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?) · accusative 'a voice' (ቃለ ሠናየ 'a good voice') · 'sound of' (construct: ቃለ ቀርን 'sound of the horn')
ለአዳም: አዳም — of/for Adam · Adam as object, marked with ለ- (ሤሞ ለአዳም 'he appointed Adam')
ፈጠራ: ፈጠረ — he created her (3ms perfect, G, f-ṭ-r; + -ኣ 'her')
ለባሕርይ: ባሕርይ — the pearl (ለ- marking the object, resumed by -ዋ in ጾርክምዋ)
ከርሡ: ከርሥ — his belly, his body (noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
ተወልደት: ተወልደ — be born (3fs perfect, passive T stem)
ገብራ: ገብር — her servant (noun + -ኣ 'her') · they (f.) made, did (3fp perfect, G; here a verb, not 'her servant')

ሩካቤ: ሩካቤ — intercourse, union (noun; ዘእንበለ ሩካቤ 'without intercourse')
ወለደት: ወለደ — she bore, gave birth (3fs perfect)
ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')

ወተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — and he arose (ወ- + 3ms perfect, Gt)
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
ወአዕረገነ: ዐርገ — and he made us ascend, raised us (3ms perfect, a-stem causative አዕረገ of ዐርገ 'ascend' + -ነ '1cp us'; ወ- 'and')
ኀቤሁ: ኀበ — to him (preposition + -hu, ኀቤሁ) · also 'of him' after ሰአለ 'ask' (ሰአለ ኀቤሁ 'he asked of him')
ሞትነ: ሞት — our death (noun + -ነ '1cp our') · also ሞተ — we die, we died (1cp perfect, G, used as a conditional: እመሂ ሞትነ 'whether we die', እመኒ ሞትነ 'even if we die'; m-w-t)
ለማርያም: ማርያም — Mary (proper name); ለ- marks the object
ከበርነ: ከብረ — we are honoured, glorious (1cp perfect, G, k-b-r)
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
ተነበየ: ተነበየ — he prophesied (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ነበየ, n-b-y)
መንክር: መንክር — wonder, marvel; wondrous (noun/adj.; here 'of wonder')
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
ዘቦአ: ቦአ — that (it) entered (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
ለ: ለ — to, for (preposition; separated from ርኁብ by a stray wordspace in the source)
እግዚአ: እግዚእ — lord (noun; accusative predicate in -a, after ኩን) · construct 'lord of' (እግዚአ ኵሉ 'Lord of all')
ኀያላን: ኀያል — mighty men, warriors (noun, plural ኀያላን) · mighty (adjective, plural, qualifying መላእክት 'angels': መላእክት ኀያላን 'mighty angels')
ቦአ: ቦአ — he entered (3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
ወወፅአ: ወፅአ — and he went out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-ṣ-ʾ)
ዘይቤ: ብህለ — who said, which he said (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect, defective verb b-h-l)
በአማን: አማን — truth; በአማን 'in truth, truly' (በ- + noun)
መንግሥተ: መንግሥት — kingdom (construct 'kingdom of') · also the plain accusative 'a kingdom' (ዘይነፍቅ መንግሥተ 'who would seize a kingdom')
ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)

ቅዱሳን: ቅዱስ — holy ones, holies (plural ቅዱሳን; ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን 'Holy of Holies')
ወበሐሤት: ሐሤት — and in gladness (ወ- + በ- + noun)

ገሃደ: ገሃድ — openly, evident (adjective as adverbial accusative)
በመንፈስ: መንፈስ — by the spirit (በ- 'by, in' + noun; በመንፈስ ቅዱስ 'by the Holy Spirit')

ውእቱኬ: ውእቱ — that indeed (3ms pronoun + emphatic enclitic -ኬ)
